Because of a careless nurse. <break time="0.8s" /> Whom Helen promptly dismissed. <break time="0.8s" /> Before nursing the child back to health herself. <break time="0.8s" /> Late that autumn. <break her own house. <break time="0.8s" /> Helen never tried to hide the facts. <break time="0.8s" /> For she believed. <break time="0.8s" /> That scandals only grow larger. <break time="0.8s" /> When they are hushed up. <break time="0.8s" /> And so she spoke of them freely. <break time="0.8s" /> To anyone who asked. <break time="0.8s" /> As she told it. <break time="0.8s" /> Michael was simply her dead brothers son. <break time="0.8s" /> And she had agreed. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of duty and affection. <break time="0.8s" /> To bring him up as her nephew.
